preconditions.description: The number of shamans N must be between 2 and 100,000.
The maximum number of trusted friends D must be between 1 and 500.
The number of days U must be between 0 and 200,000.
The number of questions Q must be between 1 and 50,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= H[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each shaman's altitude H_i must be between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] < N and 0 <= B[i] < N and A[i] != B[i] for i in range(U))
preconditions.description: Each trust relationship must involve two distinct shamans within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < N and 0 <= y < N and 0 <= v <= U for _ in range(Q))
preconditions.description: Each query must specify valid indices for shamans x and y, and a valid day v.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min(abs(H[x_prime] - H[y_prime]) for x_prime in trusted_friends_x for y_prime in trusted_friends_y))
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum distance between trusted friends of the suspected Thief and Evil Shaman.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if any(x_prime == y_prime for x_prime in trusted_friends_x for y_prime in trusted_friends_y) else True
postconditions.description: If a shaman is trusted by both the Thief and the Evil Shaman, the output must be 0.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1000000000' if len(trusted_friends_x) == 0 or len(trusted_friends_y) == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If either the Thief or the Evil Shaman has no trusted friends, the output must be 10^9.
